title: Embassy, Filipinos condole with families of crash victims in UAE

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Embassy in Abu Dhabi and the Filipino community in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) extended their condolences to the families of those killed in a road accident in the Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah on Tuesday. In a statement, the embassy expressed its deep sorrow over the incident and also its sincere appreciation to the emergency responders and medical teams for their assistance to those affected.
